int8.reason: some ops internally cast int8 to int32 (cast cost)

int16.reason: some ops internally cast int16 to int32 (cast cost)

uint8.reason: unsigned types are computed via int cast then cast back; overflow may occur
uint8.suggestion: Use a signed integer dtype (int32) directly instead of unsigned.

uint16.reason: unsigned types are computed via int cast then cast back; overflow may occur
uint16.suggestion: Use a signed integer dtype (int32) directly instead of unsigned.

uint32.reason: unsigned types are computed via int cast then cast back; overflow may occur
uint32.suggestion: Use a signed integer dtype (int64) directly instead of unsigned.

uint64.reason: uint64 tensors are not supported by the Ascend backend

float64.reason: float64 runs on AICPU and is significantly slower (not accelerated)

complex128.reason: complex128 runs on AICPU and is significantly slower

object.reason: object dtype (arbitrary Python objects) cannot live on device

datetime64.reason: datetime64 is not supported on device

timedelta64.reason: timedelta64 is not supported on device

str_.reason: string/unicode arrays are handled on CPU

bytes_.reason: byte-string arrays are handled on CPU
